summary: Tested the subscriptions upgrade from start to finish on the live preview (UI + API), plus the isolated backend suite (19/19 pass) and a new live API suite (15/16 pass; the one failure is a data-state finding, not a code crash). Everything listed in the request works: admin creates owner -> credentials dialog shows the temp password and email sent; force password change blocks all owner pages and the old temp password then returns 401; the gate shows while awaiting authorization; the plan card shows Rs399 and 'Awaiting authorization'; authorize is disabled with the 'being set up' message (API 503); the venue is hidden publicly until the plan is active. With an active plan: dashboard, profile save, venue config incl. operating days (Sunday off -> Sunday slots unavailable), court price/duration edit, adding a 5th court -> court-limit-message shows and the add form hides (backend 400 on a 6th court), holiday add/delete all work. Expiring-soon banner, past_due payment-issue banner, and halted/expired gate with 'Renew subscription' all work; bookings/scan stay accessible; owner writes return 403; venue hidden publicly and 404 on detail; courts preserved. Admin Manage: plan change to Growth, manual renewal, suspend/activate, new temporary login (credentials dialog) and history/audit all work; a suspended owner cannot log in. Customer OTP signup (3 steps, 60s resend cooldown, wrong code error, set-hash verify -> /dashboard) works. Regression: /book, /venues, Urban Ground detail + slot selection, customer login, finance and settings 0% commission text all OK. Mobile 390px: no page-level horizontal overflow on the 4 pages. CRITICAL DATA FINDING: during my run someone else, as super admin (actor 83120ec6), assigned a subscription to the legacy owner urbanground@gmail.com (not done by my scripts).

critical.issue: Urban Ground (owner urbanground@gmail.com, id a61285f6-...) is no longer legacy. History shows super admin actor 83120ec6: 16:11:26Z 'assigned' starter -> 16:12:09Z plan_changed to growth (expiry 2026-12-14) -> 16:15:12Z manual_renewal paid_until 2026-11-14T18:29Z (note 'wait'). Between 16:11 and 16:15 Urban Ground was non-operational (awaiting_authorization): its owner was gated and the venue was hidden publicly. paid_until is end of today IST, so after the grace period Urban Ground will be gated and hidden again. I did NOT revert it (instructed not to modify Urban Ground). Assigning a plan to a legacy owner shows no confirmation and has no undo ('remove plan / back to legacy').

minor.endpoint: POST /api/admin/owners and the venue wizard 'New owner account' (create_owner_account)
minor.issue: Creates an owner with NO subscription, so the owner gets free 'legacy' access with no plan or court limit. This bypasses the subscription model. These paths should require a plan or be removed in favour of /admin/subscriptions.
Does not check must_change_password, unlike the other owner write endpoints (low risk).
The UI shows the 'Sync with Razorpay' button even when there is no provider subscription; it always returns 400 in that case.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'New temporary login' the history/audit list is not refetched (onCreds does not call done()), so owner.invite_reissued only appears after reopening.

issues: The status badge says 'Pending Authorization' or 'Past Due' while the STATUS field says 'Awaiting authorization' or 'Active'. Mixed wording is confusing.
The authorize button stays visible but disabled even when the plan is active through a manual renewal.
Says 'Subscription payment needs attention' and shows a 2025 paid-until date. An explicit 'Subscription expired - renew' message would be clearer.

design_issues.screen: Admin subscriptions/manage, owner holidays, venue filters
issues: Use native browser date inputs (type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar.
Every action is listed twice (subscription_history + audit_logs, e.g. manual_renewal and subscription.manual_renewal). Consider deduplicating.
No aria-pressed state on the day buttons (accessibility).

action_items: CRITICAL: Decide with the user what to do about the Urban Ground subscription (assigned via admin UI at 16:11Z by super admin; manual paid_until ends 2026-11-14 IST). Either restore legacy (delete that subscription doc plus its history) or extend paid_until; otherwise Urban Ground will be gated and hidden publicly after grace.
Add a confirmation warning when assigning a plan to a legacy owner ('this owner will lose access until authorized'). Consider an admin 'revert to legacy / remove plan' action.
Make owner creation via /admin/owners and the venue wizard 'New owner' require a plan, or route it through /api/subscriptions/admin/owners, so new owners cannot get free legacy access.
Refetch Manage-dialog data after 'New temporary login'. Hide 'Sync with Razorpay' when there is no provider subscription.
Align status wording on /owner/subscription (badge vs status field). Show a distinct 'expired' banner when the state is expired.
critical_code_review_comments: sub_state(): any subscription doc without paid_until makes the owner non-operational and hides the venue publicly (venue_operational). That is intended for new owners, but it is dangerous for existing legacy owners when admin assigns a plan.
admin_routes.create_owner_account sets an admin-chosen password with must_change_password and no subscription. This is a legacy path that conflicts with the new subscription model.
issue_invite overwrites the owner's password whenever 'New temporary login' is used. That is expected, but the admin UI should warn that the current password stops working.
Signup tick(): setInterval is not cleared on unmount (minor leak if the user navigates away during the cooldown).

rca of the issue: The Urban Ground legacy state was lost because a super admin (an actor outside this test run, using the same admin account) opened Manage for urbanground@gmail.com and submitted 'Assign plan', then 'Change plan', then 'Record renewal'. POST /admin/assign inserts a pending_authorization subscription. core.sub_state() then treats the owner as awaiting_authorization (operational=False), which gates the owner dashboard and makes venue_operational() hide the venue from /api/venues. There is no confirmation and no way to revert. Fix: add a confirmation step and a revert-to-legacy action, or a grace/'legacy until authorized' state for owners who already have live venues.
